en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a mountain valley settlement framed by two tall fir trees. A village with a church steeple sits below steep, forested slopes of the Carpathians. The reverse prints the caption 'REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÂNĂ – POIANA ȚAPULUI – Vedere generală' (also in Russian), has two 20 bani Romanian People's Republic stamps, cancellation marks, a vertical imprint 'LIBRĂRIA NOASTRĂ', address lines to Ploiești, and a handwritten Romanian message.
